korean_title: [한화에어로스페이스] 2026학년도 동계 계절수업 현장실습학기제 운영 예정 안내(영어회화성적 필수)

original.text: 항공우주공학과에서 2026학년도 동계 계절수업 현장실습학기제를 운영할 예정입니다.
관심있는 학생들은 아래의 일정 및 자격조건 등을 미리 확인하시기 바랍니다.
(단, 운영 예정이므로 확정시 내용이 변경될 수 있음을 참고바랍니다.)
- 전공: 항공우주공학, 전기공학, 기계공학, 컴퓨터공학, 산업공학
- 공인어학성적 보유 필수(TOEIC Speaking 또는 OPIc에 한함) *서류접수마감일(10/19(월)예정) 기준 유효성적에 한하여 인정
* 항공우주공학과 행정실로 신청서 제출 및 한화 채용시스템에도 반드시 동시에 서류를 접수해야 함.
- 실무면접: 2026.11.4.(수)~11.6.(금) 중 하루 * 한화에어로스페이스 서울 근무지에서 진행 예정.
- 최종선발: 2026. 11. 20.(금) 예정 * 11/23(월)까지 수강료를 반드시 납부해야 함.
- 신원조회 결과 확인 및 채용검진 진행: 12월 중
* 당사는 방산기업으로서, 법령에 의거하여 신원조회 절차가 전형 내에 포함되어 있음.

english: The Department of Aerospace Engineering plans to run a 현장실습학기제 (field practicum semester: an internship taken for academic credit) during the 2026 winter seasonal session.
Interested students should check the schedule, eligibility requirements and other details below in advance.
(Please note that this programme is still being planned, so the details may change when it is confirmed.)
1. Host organisation: Hanwha Aerospace (채용연계형: recruitment-linked, meaning the internship may lead to a job offer)
2. Internship period: 28 Dec 2026 – 28 Jan 2027 (Field Practicum 3 / at least 150 hours)
- Major: Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering
- Year 3 or above (priority given to students expected to graduate in February or August 2027)
- An official language test score is required (TOEIC Speaking or OPIc only) *Only scores that are valid on the document submission deadline (planned for 19 Oct (Mon)) are accepted
* You must submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering administrative office AND, at the same time, submit your documents through the Hanwha recruitment system.
- Job interview: one day between 4 Nov 2026 (Wed) and 6 Nov (Fri) * Planned to take place at Hanwha Aerospace's Seoul office.
- Final selection: planned for 20 Nov 2026 (Fri) * You must pay the course fee by 23 Nov (Mon).
- Background check results and pre-employment medical check-up: during December
* As a defence company, Hanwha Aerospace is required by law to include a background check (신원조회: security/identity screening) as part of the selection process.
6. Contact person: 김완영 (Kim Wan-young), Department of Aerospace Engineering (perfect@snu.ac.kr / 02-880-9357)
